summary: fjl 等提交的 EIP-8141 Frame Transaction 当日合并：新交易类型的有效性与 gas 支付可抽象定义，账户可用任意密码系统定义签名方案，同时被提为 Hegotá 头号提案。chunter-cb 提交 EIP-8130 的 ERC-20 代付 gas 扩展。ACDE #229 汇总 Hegotá 头号候选，截止 2 月 4 日。aelowsson 分析 EIP-8037 的两种均衡失效模式。

items.title: 新增 EIP：Frame Transaction
items.note: （fjl）提交并合并；EIP-8141：补上 VERIFY frame 数据的省略规则（fjl）提交并合并；Magicians 讨论帖 EIP-8141（matt）10:35：新交易的有效性与 gas 支付可抽象定义，账户不再只依赖单个 ECDSA 签名，可用任意密码系统定义并解释签名方案。
items.note_en: (fjl), submitted and merged; EIP-8141: add the missing elision of VERIFY frame data (fjl), submitted and merged; Magicians thread EIP-8141 (matt), 10:35: a new transaction whose validity and gas payment are defined abstractly, so accounts no longer rely on one ECDSA signature and can define and interpret any cryptographic signature scheme.

items.title: ethresear.ch：EIP-8037 的失效模式与状态 gas 缩放
items.note: （aelowsson）20:29：当用户不愿把 50% 预算用于状态创建时会出现两种均衡失效，文章给出可部署的状态 gas 缩放修正措施。
items.title_en: ethresear.ch: Failure modes in EIP-8037 and state-gas scaling
items.note_en: (aelowsson), 20:29: two equilibrium failure modes arise when users do not want to spend 50% of their budget on state creation, and the note presents corrective state gas scaling measures.

items.title: ACDE #229
items.note: 21:00，据 Ethereal news #9：EIP-7928 BAL 的并行执行、批量读取与并行状态根为必选优化；EIP-7610 列为 CFI，EIP-7872 与 EIP-7949 拒绝纳入但客户端应统一；Hegotá 头号候选为 EIP-8141 frame 交易、EIP-8105 加密交易池、EIP-7807 SSZ 执行区块与共识层的 EIP-7805 FOCIL，提交截止 2 月 4 日。
items.note_en: 21:00, per Ethereal news #9: EIP-7928 BAL parallel execution, batch reads and parallel state root are mandatory optimizations; EIP-7610 is CFI, while EIP-7872 and EIP-7949 were declined but clients should standardize; Hegotá headliner candidates are EIP-8141 frame transactions, the EIP-8105 encrypted pool, EIP-7807 SSZ execution blocks and consensus layer EIP-7805 FOCIL, with a February 4 deadline.

frame transactions proposed as a Hegotá headliner
a confidential transactions token ERC merged
summary_en: EIP-8141 Frame Transaction, submitted by fjl and coauthors, merged the same day: a new transaction type whose validity and gas payment are defined abstractly, letting accounts use any cryptographic system for signatures, and it was proposed as a Hegotá headliner. chunter-cb submitted an ERC-20 gas payment extension for EIP-8130. ACDE #229 collected Hegotá headliner candidates ahead of the February 4 deadline. aelowsson analyzed two equilibrium failure modes in EIP-8037.
